rows.note: This is the all-purpose adjective for something available or happening without delay, especially results or responses.

example.english: If there’s a problem, give me an immediate reply.
example.jyutping: jau5 me1 man6 tai4 zik1 si4 fuk1 ngo5

rows.note: Use this for the very-close or adjacent sense, including something in the immediate vicinity.

example.english: The convenience store is in the immediate vicinity of my home.
example.traditional: 間便利店離我屋企好近。
example.jyutping: gaan1 bin6 lei6 dim3 lei4 ngo5 uk1 kei2 hou2 gan6

rows.note: Use this in formal family terminology for direct-line relatives, as in immediate family.

example.english: Only immediate family members can apply.
example.jyutping: zik6 hai6 can1 suk6 sin1 ho2 ji5 san1 cing2
